$comment: Known serious/critical axe violations at the time the accessibility harness
was introduced (WP-2.7d). A route may produce ONLY the rule ids listed for
it; anything new fails the gate. Fixing a listed issue never fails a run —
the suite prints a note asking for the stale entry to be removed.
Keys are the audit key, not always the URL: authenticated entries are
'<role> <route>' because /app renders a different dashboard per role.
This file is DEBT, not policy. Entries should be deleted, never added,
outside a deliberate and recorded decision. The full WCAG AA audit is
